values.note: $29 a night in the summer season (Memorial Day weekend - Labor Day weekend, with water, trash and a host); $10 in the off-season. Cash or check in the fee envelopes at the entrance.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/palisade-campground ('Single Site: $29 per night'; 'Single Site: $10 per night (during shoulder season)'; 'Fee envelopes and a collection box are provided near the entrance'; 'Please be prepared to pay with cash or check'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Maximum spur 35 ft, but not every site takes that length. Some sites are in the open, others screened by cottonwood, aspen and spruce-fir. Overflow parking by the entrance sign.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/palisade-campground ('Maximum spur length is 35 feet. Not all sites will fit vehicles of this length.'; 'Some of the 12 sites are out in the open, while other sites are screened'; 'There is ample overflow parking near the entrance sign'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Lighted accessible vault toilet. Water and trash only Memorial Day weekend - Labor Day weekend; pack out trash and bring water the rest of the year. Summer host. Bear country.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/palisade-campground ('There is a vault type toilet with lights that is accessible'; 'Water is available in the campground during the summer season, typically Memorial Day Weekend to Labor Day Weekend. Outside of the summer season, potable water is NOT available'; 'Trash service is provided by the concessionaire from Memorial Day to Labor Day'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Open year-round but may be inaccessible from snow or spring road closures; full service (water, trash, host, higher fee) Memorial Day weekend - Labor Day weekend (2026 concessionaire season began May 22).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/palisade-campground ('Open year-round, but may be inaccessible due to snow levels or spring road closures. From Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day weekend, there are higher fees, water, and trash service.'; 'Concessionaire operations for the 2026 season will begin May 22nd. Campground is currently in off season'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: First-come, first-served only. Popular; usually full mid-June through August, so arrive early afternoon.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/palisade-campground ('All sites are first come, first served and cannot be reserved.'; '14-day camping limit.'; 'It tends to stay full from mid-June through August. Early afternoon arrival is recommended.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Senior/Access passes: 50% off single sites, only the site the pass holder occupies.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/palisade-campground ('Interagency Senior/Access Recreation Passes provide a 50% discount to single campsites ONLY.'), read 2026-10-28

note: Rio Grande NF campground right on the Rio Grande, the only one in the canyon between South Fork (7.3 mi) and Creede (12.1 mi), on CO-149 at ~8,300 ft. Active railroad tracks run through the campground and the highway borders it with no screening, so expect traffic and the occasional scenic train. --Claude
summary: FS page: confirmed 12 sites, no hookups, FCFS only, vault toilet, summer water, $29 summer / $10 off-season. Added max 35 ft, season (open year-round, full service Memorial Day - Labor Day), 14-day limit, senior/access 50%. Note trimmed of field facts.
